_comment: Copy this file into arena_mcp/environments.local/<name>.json (e.g. sandbox.json) and fill in real values, or use the set_environment(..., save_as="<name>") / switch_environment MCP tools to create one without hand-editing JSON. Every field is optional — anything omitted falls through to the plain ARENA_* values in .env. That directory is gitignored (environments.local/); never commit real credentials.
token_url: <override ARENA_TOKEN_URL, or omit to use the default>
api_base: <override ARENA_API_BASE, or omit to use the default>
